title.en: An Act Establishing a High School in Barangay Bacusanon, Municipality of Pangantucan, Province of Bukidnon, to Be Known as the Bacusanon High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a High School in Barangay Bacusanon, Municipality of Pangantucan, Province of Bukidnon, to Be Known as the Bacusanon High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông tại Barangay Bacusanon, Thị trấn Pangantucan, Tỉnh Bukidnon được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông Bacusanon
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาในบารังไกย์ Bacusanon, เทศบาล Pangantucan, จังหวัด Bukidnon ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Bacusanon
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas di Barangay Bacusanon, Kotamadya Pangantucan, Provinsi Bukidnon dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Bacusanon
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah di Barangay Bacusanon, Perbandaran Pangantucan, Wilayah Bukidnon dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Bacusanon

text.en: There shall be established a high school in Barangay Bacusanon, Municipality of Pangantucan, Province of Bukidnon, to be known as the Bacusanon High School.
The Secretary of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act is hereby authorized to be appropriated in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
